# DesignYourQR

> A completely free online QR code generator with custom designs: no sign-up, no watermark, no scan limits, no expiry, and free for commercial use. Everything runs in the visitor's browser, so no data leaves the device.

DesignYourQR makes static QR codes that are free in every sense. Unlike many QR generators, it does not watermark your code, cap how many times it can be scanned, make it expire, or lock design features behind a paywall or an account. Every code is a plain static QR that you own outright and can use commercially.

It encodes links, plain text, Wi-Fi networks, email, phone, SMS and contact cards (vCard), with custom module and corner shapes, solid or gradient colors, logo embedding (with automatic background removal), and optional labels or frames. Codes export as PNG, SVG, JPG or WebP up to 4096 px, with an optional transparent background. The interface is available in English and Hebrew (right-to-left).

## Pages
- [Free QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/): the generator itself, completely free, in English.
- [Free QR code generator in Hebrew](https://designyourqr.com/?lang=he): the same tool with a Hebrew, right-to-left interface.
- [Privacy policy](https://designyourqr.com/privacy): QR generation is client-side; links, passwords and uploaded logos are never sent to a server.

## Why it is genuinely free
Many QR generators advertise a free tier but then watermark the download, expire the code after a trial, cap scans, or require an account or a credit card. DesignYourQR does none of that. Every code is a static QR that is free forever, has no watermark, no scan limit and no expiry, is fine for commercial use, and is generated entirely in your browser so nothing you enter is uploaded. A static code cannot expire because the content is stored inside the image itself, with no server in the loop. See [Free QR code generator with no watermark](https://designyourqr.com/free-qr-code-no-watermark) for a feature comparison.

## Common questions
- Is it really free? Yes. Every code is a static QR with no watermark, no scan limit and no expiry, and commercial use is allowed. There is no account and no credit card.
- Which QR generator has no watermark? DesignYourQR downloads are clean; no watermark is added unless you add a label yourself.
- Do the codes expire? No. A static QR holds the content itself, so it keeps working with no server and no subscription.
- Is my data private? Yes. Generation happens in your browser; links, Wi-Fi passwords and uploaded logos are never sent to a server.
- Can I add a logo without a watermark? Yes. Drop a logo in the center; error correction rises to High automatically and the download has no watermark.

## Use-case guides
- [Wi-Fi QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/wifi-qr-code): a code guests scan to join a network without typing the password.
- [vCard QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/vcard-qr-code): a digital business card that saves contact details straight to a phone.
- [QR code for restaurant menus](https://designyourqr.com/qr-code-for-menu): link an online menu, free and with no monthly fee or expiry.
- [QR code with a logo](https://designyourqr.com/qr-code-with-logo): embed a logo that stays scannable, with no watermark on the download.
- [Instagram QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/instagram-qr-code): a code to an Instagram profile that opens from any phone camera.
- [Email QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/email-qr-code): a code that opens a prefilled email (mailto).
- [Phone number QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/phone-qr-code): a code that starts a call (tel).
- [SMS QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/sms-qr-code): a code that opens a prefilled text message.
- [WhatsApp QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/whatsapp-qr-code): a code that opens a WhatsApp chat (wa.me click-to-chat), with an optional prefilled message.
- [Google review QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/google-review-qr-code): a code customers scan to leave a Google review, for collecting more reviews.

## Guides
- [Static vs dynamic QR codes](https://designyourqr.com/static-vs-dynamic-qr-code): the difference between static and dynamic QR codes, why static codes never expire, and when to use each.

## For websites and developers
- [Embed the QR code generator](https://designyourqr.com/embed-qr-code-generator): add a free QR code generator to any website with one line of HTML (an iframe), no API key and no sign-up. The widget itself lives at https://designyourqr.com/embed and generates codes client-side.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/humus1337/qr): the whole site is open source (MIT), with no backend and no build step.
- [designyourqr on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/designyourqr): the same QR renderer as a JavaScript library, for styled SVG QR codes in Node or the browser.
- [WordPress plugin](https://wordpress.org/plugins/designyourqr/): a [designyourqr] shortcode and a block editor block that draw styled QR codes on any WordPress site, in the official WordPress.org plugin directory.
